title: A LANE — a unit of executed work, with a lifecycle
_role: The level the model was missing. A ROUTE (L2) is a strategic option — 'could we do X?'. A REQUIREMENT is 'what must be TRUE'. A LANE is 'we RAN X, and here is how it ended'. Executed work had no object, so its state lived only as ~~strikethrough~~ in roadmap prose — and prose is not queryable, which is how an artifact belonging to a lane that CLOSED on 2026-07-30 was read as a gap to fill on 2026-08-05 and cost 88.5 minutes of CI.

id.description: Matches the `LANE n` the documents already use. The namespace is theirs; this register does not invent one.

aliases.description: Where one board row covers two lane numbers ('LANE 9/20', 'LANE 17/21'), so a reader searching either finds this.

state.description: ⛔ NO VAGUE STATES. The question this must answer is 'will this lane still produce what it owes?' — `complete` NO (it ended), `held` and `parked` MAYBE (paused behind a named gate or trigger), `running` YES. A verdict is NOT a state: whether the answer was positive or null belongs in `terminus`, because collapsing them would make 'it failed' and 'it is unfinished' render alike.

terminus.description: How it ended, or what it is waiting on — in the document's own words where possible. For `complete` this carries the verdict, INCLUDING a null one.

gate.description: For `held`/`parked`: the named thing that would restart it. A pause with no named gate is indistinguishable from an abandonment.

produces.description: Every artifact this lane was responsible for, PRODUCED OR NOT. ⭐ This is what makes an absence answerable from the model instead of from prose: an artifact whose lane is `complete` and which was never produced is a WITHDRAWN citation, and one whose lane is `running` is EXPECTED. check_artifacts derives the disposition from here rather than asking a human to assert it.

serves.description: The rung, instrument or requirement this lane feeds — `RUNG 5a-KS`, `V5`, `R11`.

cost_realized.description: ⚠ POINTS at the ledger, never a second copy of a figure. realised-spend.json is the one home.

owner.description: The narrative home. The model carries the structured facts; the document keeps the story, and check_lane_source_agreement stops them diverging.
